source.source_locator: 危険物の規制に関する政令 第24条第1号

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 製造所等では許可・届出に係る品名・数量等の範囲を超えて危険物を貯蔵・取扱いしない。
evidence.tested_misconception: 指定数量未満なら許可品名外でも扱える。
evidence.reasoning_path: facility authorization -> compare name/quantity with permitted/notified scope -> prohibit excess

collision.note: B3 Tier A; distinct from B1 quantity-multiple calculation and B2 licensing duties.

independent_review.rationale: Exact Article 24(1) authorization boundary; distinct from B1 quantity arithmetic.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 22 accepted candidates test concrete storage and handling duties, quantitative boundaries, Class-4-specific controls, or explicit sale/record obligations without material collision with the 29 canonical Otsu4 questions. C016 and C017 are too abstract to add sufficient practice value and must not proceed merely to preserve the planned count.
